text:
מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מֶֽלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּים
שֶׁהֶֽחֱזַֽרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה
רַבָּה אֱמֽוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
meaning: "I give thanks before you, King living and eternal, for you have returned my soul within me with compassion; abundant is your faithfulness." Said on waking. (A woman says Modah ani.)
purpose: To begin the day in gratitude.
note: The Jewish prayer on waking, said before washing the hands and before the morning blessings.
source: Jewish morning prayer; text and translation as printed in the Wikipedia article on Modeh Ani
name: Modeh Ani
iast:
Modeh ani lefanekha melekh ḥai vekayam,
sheheḥezarta bi nishmati b’ḥemlah,
rabah emunatekha.
pronunciation: mo-DEH a-NEE le-fa-NE-kha ME-lekh khai ve-ka-YAM; she-he-khe-ZAR-ta bee nish-ma-TEE be-khem-LAH; ra-BAH e-moo-na-TE-kha
